name: Blueprint
description: A CV builder with editable templates, a live preview and PDF export.
points: Three editable templates, a readiness check and job-keyword matching.
CVs are saved in the browser and export as PDF or JSON. AI suggestions are optional.

name: Daniel’s Gallery
description: An interactive gallery with five rooms of art, wallpapers, portraits and visual experiments.
points: Five rooms, from live works you take part in to a page-turning notebook.
An ambient soundtrack, generated live, plays only if you choose.

name: Homeless Support Finder
description: A support site that helps people find shelters, food banks and other local services.
points: A map of support services, plus practical guides on housing and mental health.
Ways to ask for help anonymously or contact someone directly.

name: Rock, Paper, Scissors
description: Play rock, paper, scissors against the computer and keep track of your score.
points: Built from a Frontend Mentor design challenge.
